name: json_schema
description: JSON Schema validation and default-value enrichment in SQL. Validate that JSON columns conform to a schema, lint the schema itself, generate JSON-Patch operations that fill in missing defaults, and apply those defaults in place. Targets JSON Schema draft-07.

cta.title: Validate JSON in SQL
cta.description: Install JSON Schema to enforce data contracts on JSON columns at query time — useful for API ingest checks, ETL data-quality gates, and config validation.

quickStart.title: Validate a JSON document against a schema
Verify the schema itself is well-formed
quickStart.sql:
SET VARIABLE event_schema = '{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema","type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"integer","default":5},"name":{"type":"string"}},"required":["id"]}';

SELECT json_schema_validate_schema(getvariable('event_schema')) AS schema_ok;

quickStart.title: Compute a JSON-Patch that fills in missing defaults
quickStart.sql:
SET VARIABLE event_schema = '{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema","type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"integer","default":5},"name":{"type":"string"}},"required":["id"]}';

SELECT TRY(json_schema_patch(getvariable('event_schema'), payload)) AS patch FROM events;

quickStart.title: Or apply the defaults inline
quickStart.sql:
SET VARIABLE event_schema = '{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema","type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"integer","default":5},"name":{"type":"string"}},"required":["id"]}';

SELECT TRY(json_schema_update(getvariable('event_schema'), payload)) AS enriched FROM events;
